## SQ3e (new): Gou-style per-neuron hemispheric bias index

This block keeps your SQ3d region-level endpoint unchanged, and adds a
Gou-style **per-neuron** asymmetry endpoint:

$$LI_j = \frac{contra_j - ipsi_j}{contra_j + ipsi_j + \epsilon}$$

where `ipsi_j` and `contra_j` are neuron-level total projection
strengths.

**Current-data clarification (important):** in this dataset, if we apply
a strict bilateral-projection criterion (`ipsi_j > 0` and
`contra_j > 0`), the usable neuron count is very small (about 6).
Therefore SQ3e is treated as **descriptive / exploratory** here;
inferential p-values are only reported when both sides have minimally
usable sample size.

```{r sq3e_per_neuron_li, fig.width=13, fig.height=8}
eps_li_n <- 1e-8
MIN_N_PER_SIDE_SQ3E <- 3L

ipsi_total <- colSums(mat_ipsi, na.rm = TRUE)
contra_total <- colSums(mat_contra, na.rm = TRUE)

li_neuron_df <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    ipsi_total = ipsi_total[match(NeuronID, names(ipsi_total))],
    contra_total = contra_total[match(NeuronID, names(contra_total))]
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    LI_neuron = (contra_total - ipsi_total) / (contra_total + ipsi_total + eps_li_n),
    valid_total = is.finite(LI_neuron) & is.finite(ipsi_total) & is.finite(contra_total),
    bilateral_proj = (ipsi_total > 0) & (contra_total > 0)
  )

cat(sprintf("SQ3e data source: %s\n", PATH_INS_XLSX))
cat(sprintf("SQ3e: all neurons in meta = %d\n", nrow(meta)))
cat(sprintf("SQ3e: valid LI neurons (finite totals) = %d\n", sum(li_neuron_df$valid_total, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("SQ3e: bilateral-projecting neurons (all types) = %d\n", sum(li_neuron_df$valid_total & li_neuron_df$bilateral_proj, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("SQ3e: bilateral-projecting ITc neurons = %d\n", sum(li_neuron_df$valid_total & li_neuron_df$bilateral_proj & li_neuron_df$Neuron_Type == "ITc", na.rm = TRUE)))

li_neuron_df <- li_neuron_df %>%
  filter(valid_total, bilateral_proj)

cat(sprintf("SQ3e: valid bilateral-projecting neurons for per-neuron LI = %d\n", nrow(li_neuron_df)))
cat("SQ3e: side counts among bilateral-projecting neurons\n")
print(li_neuron_df %>% count(Soma_Side, name = "n"))

# Overall L vs R comparison (same side label as in current notebook: source Soma_Side)
sq3e_overall <- li_neuron_df %>%
  group_by(Soma_Side) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_LI = median(LI_neuron, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_LI = mean(LI_neuron, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

enough_for_overall_test <- (
  n_distinct(li_neuron_df$Soma_Side) == 2L &&
  sum(li_neuron_df$Soma_Side == "L") >= MIN_N_PER_SIDE_SQ3E &&
  sum(li_neuron_df$Soma_Side == "R") >= MIN_N_PER_SIDE_SQ3E
)

if (!enough_for_overall_test) {
  message(
    "SQ3e: bilateral-projection sample is too small/imbalanced for stable L vs R inference; ",
    "report LI descriptively only (set p-values to NA)."
  )
}

sq3e_overall_test <- if (enough_for_overall_test) {
  p <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(LI_neuron ~ Soma_Side, data = li_neuron_df, exact = FALSE)$p.value),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  data.frame(
    stratum = "all_neurons",
    p_mwu = p,
    p_raw = p,
    n_L = sum(li_neuron_df$Soma_Side == "L"),
    n_R = sum(li_neuron_df$Soma_Side == "R"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>% add_family_inference(p_col = "p_raw", family_id = "sq3e_all_neurons", adjust_method = "none")
} else {
  data.frame(
    stratum = "all_neurons",
    p_mwu = NA_real_,
    p_raw = NA_real_,
    n_L = sum(li_neuron_df$Soma_Side == "L"),
    n_R = sum(li_neuron_df$Soma_Side == "R"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>% add_family_inference(p_col = "p_raw", family_id = "sq3e_all_neurons", adjust_method = "none")
}

# Type-stratified Gou-style tests
sq3e_type_test <- li_neuron_df %>%
  group_by(Neuron_Type) %>%
  filter(
    n_distinct(Soma_Side) == 2L,
    sum(Soma_Side == "L") >= MIN_N_PER_SIDE_SQ3E,
    sum(Soma_Side == "R") >= MIN_N_PER_SIDE_SQ3E
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_L = sum(Soma_Side == "L"),
    n_R = sum(Soma_Side == "R"),
    median_L = median(LI_neuron[Soma_Side == "L"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_R = median(LI_neuron[Soma_Side == "R"], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_mwu = tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(LI_neuron ~ Soma_Side, exact = FALSE)$p.value),
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  add_family_inference(p_col = "p_mwu", family_id = "sq3e_type_stratified", adjust_method = "BH") %>%
  arrange(p_adj, desc(abs(median_L - median_R)))

cat("SQ3e: Overall per-neuron LI summary\n")
print(sq3e_overall)
cat("SQ3e: Overall L vs R Mann-Whitney\n")
print(sq3e_overall_test)
cat("SQ3e: Type-stratified per-neuron LI Mann-Whitney (BH)\n")
print(sq3e_type_test)

# Visualization
sq3e_p1 <- ggplot(li_neuron_df, aes(x = Soma_Side, y = LI_neuron, fill = Soma_Side)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.45, width = 0.9) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(L = "#E74C3C", R = "#3498DB")) +
  labs(
    title = "SQ3e: Gou-style per-neuron hemispheric bias",
    subtitle = "LI_j = (contra - ipsi)/(contra + ipsi + eps); overall L vs R",
    x = "Source side",
    y = "Per-neuron LI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

sq3e_p2 <- ggplot(li_neuron_df, aes(x = LI_neuron, color = Soma_Side, fill = Soma_Side)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Neuron_Type, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(L = "#E74C3C", R = "#3498DB")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(L = "#E74C3C", R = "#3498DB")) +
  labs(
    title = "SQ3e: Per-neuron LI by neuron type",
    subtitle = "Density view; L/R groups overlaid",
    x = "Per-neuron LI",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

sq3e_fig <- (sq3e_p1 / sq3e_p2) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.25), guides = "collect")
print(sq3e_fig)
save_plot(sq3e_fig, "sq3e_per_neuron_li.png", width = 13, height = 9.5)

# Exports
save_table(li_neuron_df, "sq3e_per_neuron_li_values.csv")
save_stats(sq3e_overall, "sq3e_overall_li_summary.csv")
save_stats(sq3e_overall_test, "sq3e_overall_li_mwu.csv")
save_stats(sq3e_type_test, "sq3e_type_stratified_li_mwu.csv")

cleanup_vars(c(
  "eps_li_n", "ipsi_total", "contra_total", "li_neuron_df",
  "MIN_N_PER_SIDE_SQ3E", "enough_for_overall_test",
  "sq3e_overall", "sq3e_overall_test", "sq3e_type_test",
  "sq3e_p1", "sq3e_p2", "sq3e_fig"
))
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## SQ4: Are **pairwise FNT distances** concordant with **pairwise projection distances**?

**Hypothesis**: Pairs closer in morphology tend to be closer in
projection space (direction and strength of association are empirical).\
**Method**: On `common_ids`, **Mantel test** correlates the two distance
matrices with a permutation null (proper inference for matrix-valued
dependence). A raw **Spearman correlation** on upper-triangle pairs
duplicates entries and **does not yield a valid independent-sample
p-value**; we still report **rho** descriptively and use **Mantel's
permuted p** for significance.\
Projection distance here is Bray-Curtis on **per-neuron
proportion-normalized** profiles (pattern-focused endpoint).

```{r sq4_mantel, eval=has_fnt}
ut <- upper.tri(fnt_sub)
# Visualization-only min-max normalization of FNT distance to [0,1]
# (Mantel inference remains on raw fnt_sub distance matrix).
fnt01 <- fnt_sub
fnt_lo <- min(fnt_sub[ut], na.rm = TRUE)
fnt_hi <- max(fnt_sub[ut], na.rm = TRUE)
if (is.finite(fnt_lo) && is.finite(fnt_hi) && fnt_hi > fnt_lo) {
  fnt01[ut] <- (fnt_sub[ut] - fnt_lo) / (fnt_hi - fnt_lo)
  fnt01[lower.tri(fnt01)] <- t(fnt01)[lower.tri(fnt01)]
} else {
  fnt01[ut] <- 0
  fnt01[lower.tri(fnt01)] <- 0
}
diag(fnt01) <- 0

fv <- fnt01[ut]
pv <- proj_dist[ut]

# Descriptive association only — pairs are not independent; do not interpret cor.test p-value
sp_rho <- suppressWarnings(cor(fv, pv, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
cat(sprintf("Spearman rho (upper triangle, descriptive) = %.3f\n", sp_rho))

mt <- mantel(as.dist(fnt_sub), as.dist(proj_dist), method = "spearman", permutations = PERM_N)
print(mt)
sq4_summary <- data.frame(
  statistic = unname(mt$statistic),
  p = unname(mt$signif)
) %>%
  add_family_inference(p_col = "p", family_id = "sq4_single_mantel", adjust_method = "none")
print(sq4_summary)
save_stats(sq4_summary, "sq4_mantel_summary.csv")

ggplot(data.frame(FNT01 = fv, Proj = pv), aes(FNT01, Proj)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 60) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1) +
  labs(title = "SQ4: Pairwise FNT(0-1) vs pairwise projection distance (Bray-prop, upper triangle)",
       subtitle = sprintf("Spearman rho=%.3f (descriptive); inference: Mantel p", sp_rho)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## SQ5: How to compare the two distance matrices side by side in heatmaps?

**Key idea**: Both heatmaps must use the **same row/column order** (here
from a fused clustering signal). A third panel shows
**\|**$\Delta rank$\| per pair to show rank-order disagreement between
`FNT01` and projection distances (robust for sparse, non-parametric
data).\
`Proj` is the SQ4/SQ5 endpoint: Bray-Curtis on per-neuron
proportion-normalized profiles.

```{r sq5_heatmaps, eval=has_fnt, fig.height=5, fig.width=14}
ut_h <- upper.tri(fnt_sub)
side_lab <- meta_fnt$Soma_Side[match(rownames(fnt_sub), meta_fnt$NeuronID)]
ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Side = side_lab,
  col = list(Side = c(L = "#E74C3C", R = "#3498DB"))
)

# Visualization-only min-max normalization of FNT to [0,1]
fnt01_h <- fnt_sub
fnt_h_lo <- min(fnt_sub[ut_h], na.rm = TRUE)
fnt_h_hi <- max(fnt_sub[ut_h], na.rm = TRUE)
if (is.finite(fnt_h_lo) && is.finite(fnt_h_hi) && fnt_h_hi > fnt_h_lo) {
  fnt01_h[ut_h] <- (fnt_sub[ut_h] - fnt_h_lo) / (fnt_h_hi - fnt_h_lo)
  fnt01_h[lower.tri(fnt01_h)] <- t(fnt01_h)[lower.tri(fnt01_h)]
} else {
  fnt01_h[ut_h] <- 0
  fnt01_h[lower.tri(fnt01_h)] <- 0
}
diag(fnt01_h) <- 0

# Rank-based mismatch (robust to scale and tail differences):
# compare relative pair ordering between FNT and projection distances.
f_vals <- fnt01_h[ut_h]
p_vals <- proj_dist[ut_h]
f_rank01 <- (rank(f_vals, ties.method = "average") - 1) / (length(f_vals) - 1)
p_rank01 <- (rank(p_vals, ties.method = "average") - 1) / (length(p_vals) - 1)
diff_rank <- abs(f_rank01 - p_rank01)

rank_mismatch <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(fnt01_h), ncol = ncol(fnt01_h),
                        dimnames = dimnames(fnt01_h))
rank_mismatch[ut_h] <- diff_rank
rank_mismatch[lower.tri(rank_mismatch)] <- t(rank_mismatch)[lower.tri(rank_mismatch)]
diag(rank_mismatch) <- NA

combo <- (fnt01_h + proj_dist / max(proj_dist)) / 2
ord <- hclust(as.dist(combo))$order

rcols <- function(x, utm) {
  colorRamp2(quantile(x[utm], c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)), c("white", "orange", "red4"))
}

Heatmap(fnt01_h, name = "FNT01", col = rcols(fnt01_h, ut_h),
        left_annotation = ha, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
        row_order = ord, column_order = ord, show_row_names = FALSE, show_column_names = FALSE) +
Heatmap(proj_dist, name = "Proj", col = rcols(proj_dist, ut_h),
        left_annotation = ha, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
        row_order = ord, column_order = ord, show_row_names = FALSE, show_column_names = FALSE) +
Heatmap(rank_mismatch, name = "|Δrank|",
        col = colorRamp2(quantile(rank_mismatch, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE), c("white", "tan", "brown4")),
        left_annotation = ha, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
        row_order = ord, column_order = ord, show_row_names = FALSE, show_column_names = FALSE,
        column_title = "|rank(FNT01) - rank(Proj)|")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## SQ6 removed in hybrid script

SQ6 (type-stratified PERMANOVA) is intentionally removed here because it
is not meaningful under the current small and imbalanced sample regime.
Interpretation should rely on SQ3/SQ3c (multivariate pattern) and
SQ3d/SQ3e (LI summaries with explicit small-n caveats).
